result:
The fix works on every leg, and PR #288 is now marked ready.

**Why attempt 1 didn't finish:** it was waiting on two device runs and on CI, which was also the first compile of the change. It ended correctly, but it left the PR in draft. That is now recorded in `docs/lanes/vshsubneg255/NOTES.md`.

**Results.** Both runs were clean: all 10 captures, nothing missing or stale, test log completed normally.

| arm | ref | Exceptional Float | counts |
|---|---|---|---|
| fix | 6a183e3061 | **IDENTICAL** to the console (`0,-0,0,-0`) | 3 IDENTICAL / 7 DIFFERS |
| base | d92ae5d7f3 | DIFFERS (`0,0,0,0`) | 2 IDENTICAL / 8 DIFFERS |

- **Must move:** -MaxSub and -MinSub both moved to the console's `-0.000000`.
- **Must not move:** I diffed the two score reports. Only the Exceptional Float block changed. ILU RCP (#233) and MAC mov stay IDENTICAL. The other suites were already wrong before this change and have the same differences in both arms.
- **Where the value was lost:** hakuX never lost the sign. The guest's printf prints -0.0 as `0.000000`. So the console's `-0.000000` means its value was a tiny negative number: silicon does not flush a denormal passed through a MOV. The mistake was #233's flush of the inputs and the MAC results. The fix keeps the flush only on the ILU, both in and out.

**Caveats:**
- The runs happened on the **Nova**, not the Thor the brief asked for. I've said so on the PR and the issue. Thor and Nova have always agreed per capture, so I didn't request a Thor rerun.
- MAC arithmetic (MUL/ADD/MAD/DP*) on a denormal is still unmeasured; the only MAC evidence is MOV.

**Other changes this session:**
- I merged origin/master in. It was a merge, not a rebase, so both run refs stay in the branch history. The only conflict was the generated `docs/testing/nv2a_index.json`, which I rebuilt over the pinned test trees.
- Preflight passes on 99b2c6c659, and the PR's `Files:` line matches the diff. That head hasn't been through CI yet; the earlier green result was on 806d24916c.
- I posted the verdict on #288 and #255.
- When cleaning up my own temp files I deleted the untracked `.scratch/` directory. It also held attempt 1's scratch harness, which was never compiled or run.
